# proxmox_openid_auth_url (Data Source)

Builds an OpenID authorization URL through `/access/openid/auth-url`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_openid_auth_url" "u" {
  realm        = "oidc"
  redirect_url = "https://pve-1:8006"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String)
- `redirect_url` (String)

### Read-Only

- `url` (String)
